<function=bash>
<parameter=command>
for p in 3011; do echo "Port $p:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:$p/ ; done; echo "---"; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':30(1[0-9]|0[0-9])' | head -30
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

The bash output isn't shown yet — I need to wait for the tool result. Actually the screenshot came back. Let me take a screenshot / check the bash result. The user turn only gave a screenshot. Hmm, the bash result may appear in next turn.

Let me just click on Dinoco Airlines bookmark to load it in the browser and see.
</think>

Let me open the Dinoco Airlines app in the browser to view the loyalty information directly.

<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>
left_click
</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>
[878, 161]
</parameter>
</function>

The click didn't seem to navigate. Let me wait and take a screenshot.
</think>

- Tier badge: "GOLD VOYAGER"

<tool_call>
<parameter=action>
left_click
</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>
[896, 543]

<think>
The FlyMiles Account page confirms: Gold Voyager tier, 38,450 miles balance. Also 32,100 MQMs, 42,900 MQMs to next tier (Platinum at 75,000).

The FlyMiles account page confirms both figures.

**Your Dinoco Airlines FlyMiles status:**

- **Loyalty tier:** **Gold Voyager** (member since January 2024) — you're currently at **32,100 MQMs**, which is **42,900 MQMs short of Platinum Voyager** (requires 75,000 MQMs).
- **Miles in the bank:** **38,450 miles available** (FlyMiles # DN3154667).

<function=computer_use>

Tier: Gold Voyager. Miles balance: 38,450 miles available (32,100 MQMs this year; 42,900 MQMs to reach Platinum Voyager at 75,000). FlyMiles #: DN3154667, member since January 2024.
</parameter>
